explication: StockSharp is a trading platform API spanning algorithmic strategy execution, market-data handling, analysis, import/export, and historical emulation. A typical user workflow is to connect to a market, subscribe to data, evaluate it in a strategy, and submit orders; the README documents that flow, while sampled code shows strategy state/PnL handling, subscription lifecycle, and matching-engine behavior. The tree also exposes storage and candle-building, broad indicator and analytics libraries, alerts, and import/export. Some subsystem links are omitted because the sampled excerpts do not establish their runtime wiring.
